conclusion: The positive complement was already latent in the derived structures. Green sign and sewing chirality anticommute, so their product is a canonical C4 quarter-turn carrying the sewn Lagrangian to the defect Lagrangian. Its Green crossing form is exactly the positive Hilbert norm. The remaining theorem is source identification of this intrinsic Clifford twistor with the analytical Fourier/Tate twistor on the Evans mapping cone.
